description: ESDM One Map (Geoportal Kementerian ESDM) is a data portal run by Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources, Indonesia. The geoportal displays energy and mineral spatial layers such as power plants, transmission lines, oil and gas facilities, working areas, geothermal, and geological hazard layers, with web map services. Coverage: Indonesia. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as wms, wfs, viewer; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("ESDM One Map - Exploring Energy and Mineral Resources of Indonesia") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support energy infrastructure mapping and hazard exposure studies of Indonesia. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
